verdict.rationale: Deel is a workforce/payroll SaaS platform, not an AI agent or assistant; the evidence shows Deel ships an MCP *server* exposing its own data/tools to external AI agents (Claude, ChatGPT), which is the opposite direction from this story's ask of plugging external MCP servers into Deel so it can consume their tools. There is no agent/client role for Deel to plug servers into, so this axis is a category error for this product type.
